bridge_equivalence.name: megatron_env_torchrun_2rank_replicated_control_plane
bridge_equivalence.note: NOT tensor parallel: each of the 2 torchrun ranks builds a full-replica CPU MockTrainer (gpu_ids=[]) and rank 0 answers. Validates only the control plane: every op broadcast to every rank in order, per-rank status gather, rank LoRA-hash and logprob-digest agreement. No TP numerics are exercised.

transport.note: echo through the trainer server (megatron env, process launcher, CPU); one round trip = request + reply, each a torch.save blob over a localhost socket. tcp_nodelay=True is the production setting (bridge.set_nodelay on both ends); tcp_nodelay=False keeps Nagle on both ends (RemoteTrainer(tcp_nodelay=False)). Both servers run at once and every repeat pings both (order alternates per repeat). The node is shared with other agents: see load_average_1_5_15.

incident.what: CPU-only runs before 0738241 (tests and the first bench runs, no lease) created a CUDA context on GPU 0 for their duration: torch 2.13 Adam.step probes torch.accelerator.current_stream() even for CPU parameters.
